meta.name: google-maps-scraper
meta.description: Find businesses, leads, emails, reviews, ratings, and contact details from Google Maps. Use for requests such as "find dentists in Berlin", "scrape Google Maps", "get local business leads", or "collect Google Maps reviews". Runs the open-source scraper locally with Docker and guides nontechnical users through setup, monitoring, and results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从谷歌地图批量提取商家联系方式和评价
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要整理本地商家潜在客户或做市场调研
copy.tagline_en: Extract business details, leads, and reviews from Google Maps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to compile local business lists for prospecting or research.

howto.what: 装好后,你让 Claude 找商家、线索、邮箱、评论等,它会在本机用 Docker 运行抓取工具,结束后给出汇总表格,并提供保存、分析、筛选、导出等后续操作。
howto.when: 当你说出『找某类商家/地点』『抓取 Google Maps』『获取商家线索』等,或要求收集评论、评分、邮箱等联系信息时触发。

say.note: 按社区拆分地点,抓取约 20 条结果并显示摘要。

say.text: 抓取伦敦前 50 家意大利餐厅的评论
say.note: 运行抓取并附带评论(需要 JSON 输出)。

say.text: 获取纽约的本地商家线索,并提取邮箱
say.note: 以 CSV 格式抓取商家信息并附邮箱列。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can scrape Google Maps to find businesses, leads, emails, reviews, ratings, and contact details. It runs the open-source scraper locally via Docker, shows a summary table, and offers save, analyze, filter, export, or deeper scraping.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find businesses or places, scrape Google Maps, get leads, or collect reviews, ratings, emails, and contacts.

say_en.note: Splits query by neighborhoods and scrapes ~20 results per query.

say_en.text: Scrape reviews for top 50 Italian restaurants in London
say_en.note: Runs scrape with extra reviews (requires JSON output).

say_en.text: Get local business leads in New York and extract emails
say_en.note: Scrapes businesses to CSV and includes an emails column.
